seo.title: Process — How It Works | Jobsite Systems
seo.description: Six clear steps from first call to a live, maintained trade-business website. No long discovery, no surprise invoices.

header.heading: How It Works — And Why It's Simple
header.lead: Six clear steps from first call to a live, maintained trade-business website.
header.callout: Total client time: ~2 hours across two weeks. Most of the wait is on us, not on you.

timeline.title: Intro Call
timeline.lead: A short call to cover your services, trades, service area, and what you want the site to do. No pitch — we listen, answer questions, and tell you honestly whether this is a fit.
items: Discussion of your business and customers you serve
Walk-through of what's included
Clear pricing with no mystery add-ons
Honest yes/no on fit

deliverable.title: What you'll get
deliverable.body: A written scope summary and a clear path forward.

timeline.title: Content Handoff
timeline.lead: You send us what you have — license info, services, service area, photos. We give you a simple checklist and templates so nothing gets missed.
items: Service / trade checklist to fill out
Photo upload link (phone photos are fine)
Short owner bio or "about" paragraph
License, insurance, and pricing notes

deliverable.title: What you'll get
deliverable.body: A confirmation that we have everything needed to start building.

timeline.whatWeNeed: License info, services list, photos (phone photos are fine).

timeline.title: Design & Build
timeline.lead: We build your site on our trade-business template system — brand-matched colors, your photos, your services, your voice — built on simple, solid hosting.
items: Branded design based on your existing look
All your content laid out on real pages
Estimate-request form wired to your email
Local SEO basics built in from day one

deliverable.title: What you'll get
deliverable.body: A staging link you can share with your team for review.

timeline.title: Review
timeline.lead: You review the staging site. We include one round of revisions — wording, photos, section changes — to get it right before launch.
items: Full review on phone and desktop
One round of revisions included
Sign-off before launch

deliverable.title: What you'll get
deliverable.body: A finalized site ready to go live.

timeline.title: Launch
timeline.lead: We point your domain, turn on SSL, wire up analytics, register the site with Google and the AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity) — then it's live and findable everywhere.
items: Domain cutover and SSL
Analytics and form testing
Submitted to Google and Bing search engines
Ready for ChatGPT-style AI answer engines

deliverable.title: What you'll get
deliverable.body: A live site at your domain, monitored and backed up.

timeline.whatWeNeed: Domain access — we'll walk you through it.

timeline.title: Hands-Off Ongoing
timeline.lead: Your site stays up, stays updated, and stays accurate. Need a crew bio refreshed, a service area updated, or a new before-and-after photo published? One email, handled.
items: Uptime monitoring and daily backups
Small content changes handled for you
Crew bio and roster updates
Direct email support

deliverable.title: What you'll get
deliverable.body: A site that stays working year after year.

finalCta.heading: Think we're a good fit?
finalCta.body: Tell us about your business and we'll walk you through exactly what your site would include. No commitment needed.
